stable_fields.data_mr: Actual shared MemoryRegion RAM backing; 8388608 bytes

is_octal.true: error_setg: unqualified OPI; no ID/register simulation

interface.state_changes: Unused official octal MR fields and old unused dummy field removed; protocol state is private. No new property required.

implemented.backing: Only data_mr supplies memory reads and accepts writes; CPU cache and GDMA must bind to this same physical array, not create a second PSRAM allocation.
spi: EB: quad fast read, 24-bit address, 6 dummy clocks
9F: 24-bit address then 64 identifier bits, no dummy
qpi: F5: exit to SPI on CE# rising
both_modes: C0 toggles linear / aligned 32-byte wrap on CE# rising
66 arms reset; immediately following 99 resets SPI+linear on CE# rising; any intervening opcode cancels the old enable
implemented.id_semantics: Standard MF/KGD/64Mbit encoding, EID[41]=1 selects genuinely backed non-2T 8MiB. Unspecified manufacturing EID bits are deterministic zero model identity, not a measured chip ID. KGD is an emulated protocol identity, not evidence of hardware die testing. No FF manufacturer workaround, 16/32MiB fake density or claimed capacity remains.
implemented.bounds: Wire address is 24-bit; only physical A[22:0] decode. Upper wire A23 and linear end-of-array carry wrap into existing backing. This modulo physical decoder follows address width, not a measured boundary trace. C0 wrap preserves the starting aligned 32-byte block. CPU-MMU/GDMA invalid physical mappings must independently fault rather than apply this SSI-wire wrap.
implemented.dirty_tracking: CE# rising marks written actual ranges dirty, splitting linear array-end wrap; 32-byte wrap marks its actual block. SSI callback bool is the electrical level, not logical selection.
implemented.reset: SoC/controller warm reset aborts the in-flight frame, marks existing writes dirty and clears reset-enable; preserves physical RAM, QPI selection and burst mode because external PSRAM has not been power-cycled. 66/99 resets protocol SPI+linear without clearing RAM. Fresh realize allocates RAM and starts SPI+linear; initial RAM contents are not a hardware power-up value claim.

explicitly_unqualified.reason: Primary AP datasheet requires DDR edges, DQS/DM, register-dependent latency, even-address and burst rules; official byte-SSI approximation cannot qualify these semantics. No octal mode-register ID or fixed fake latency remains.
Official SSI passes bytes, not line width. Device mode gates opcode availability but cannot distinguish wrongly framed SPI versus QPI lane transactions.

Unchanged official SPI1 serializes configured dummy cycles as ceil(cycles/8) bytes, even for quad transfers. Supported 8- and 6-clock waits each consume one SSI transfer. Extra tuning dummy clocks and analog sampling correctness are not qualified.

explicitly_unqualified.mode: other densities, 2T, halfsleep, refresh, electrical timing

rejection: Unsupported or mode-invalid commands, overlong control commands and ID reads past the documented response log LOG_GUEST_ERROR and reject the rest of the CE# frame. Non-data SSI returns zero as the bus's undriven contribution; this is never a substitute for a RAM read outside backing. Reset without 66 is ignored as specified, not accepted as a reset.
